notes: Positives are greenfield design work where no code exists yet, including pitches that never say MVP or prototype, and the old name pitch-to-spec. Negatives are near-misses: feature work inside an existing repo (feature-specifier), greenfield requests that ask for code rather than a design, and already-specified work (developer/reviewer/tester).
